english.note: Use this specifically for cardiopulmonary resuscitation, especially when describing the procedure performed on someone whose heart or breathing has stopped.

examples.english: After his heart stopped, the medical staff immediately performed resuscitation on him.
examples.traditional: 佢心跳停咗之後，醫護人員即刻為佢施行心肺復甦術。
